_comment: SIFT-1M (128d L2). Tuned for high-QPS operation with recall@10 >= 0.95: head_ratio=0.1, posting_page_limit=15/search_posting_page_limit=15, internal_result_num=64, max_check=4096. On the local SIFT1M sweep this kept recall@10 around 0.9765 while reducing build wall-clock from ~212s to ~120s and keeping c1/c16 QPS close to the previous recall-heavy preset. num_threads/io_threads=32 cuts build wall-clock vs the old 16. replica_count=8 unchanged (matches SPANN paper SIFT-1B sweet spot).
